selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent IPv4 redirect and source-route hardening
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the persistent configuration, runtime values of 0, successful boot-time sysctl processing, and final verification after reboot.
Shows healthy baseline under boot ID 54bd1c3e-3a1b-4913-841b-88512119e096, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID fe4dc34c-cb2b-4893-a19e-b0448205a612, and recovered system/network health.

commands.command: for p in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_redirects /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_source_route; do printf '%s=' "$p"; cat "$p"; done

set -eu
cfg=/etc/sysctl.d/99-ipv4-network-hardening.conf
umask 022
printf '%s\n' '# IPv4 network hardening: reject ICMP redirects and source-routed packets' 'net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0' 'net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0' 'net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0' 'net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0' > "$cfg"
chmod 0644 "$cfg"
sysctl -p "$cfg"
for dir in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*; do iface=${dir##*/}; sysctl -q -w "net.ipv4.conf.${iface}.accept_redirects=0"; sysctl -q -w "net.ipv4.conf.${iface}.accept_source_route=0"; done
printf '%s\n' 'PERSISTED_CONFIG'
cat "$cfg"
printf '%s\n' 'RUNTIME_VALUES'
for p in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_redirects /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_source_route; do printf '%s=' "$p"; cat "$p"; done

set -eu
old_boot=54bd1c3e-3a1b-4913-841b-88512119e096
new_boot=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
[ "$new_boot" != "$old_boot" ]
printf 'OLD_BOOT_ID=%s\nNEW_BOOT_ID=%s\n' "$old_boot" "$new_boot"
printf 'SYSTEM_STATE='; systemctl is-system-running
printf 'NETWORK_MANAGER='; systemctl is-active NetworkManager
printf 'NODE_IP=%s\n' "$NODE_IP"
printf '%s\n' 'IPV4_ADDRS'; ip -4 -brief address show
printf '%s\n' 'IPV4_ROUTES'; ip -4 route show
gateway=$(ip -4 route show default | awk 'NR == 1 {print $3}')
[ -n "$gateway" ]
printf 'GATEWAY_REACHABILITY=%s\n' "$gateway"
ping -c 2 -W 2 "$gateway"
printf '%s\n' 'PERSISTED_CONFIG'; stat -c 'mode=%a owner=%U group=%G file=%n' /etc/sysctl.d/99-ipv4-network-hardening.conf; cat /etc/sysctl.d/99-ipv4-network-hardening.conf
printf '%s\n' 'POST_RESTART_RUNTIME_VALUES'
for p in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_redirects /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_source_route; do value=$(cat "$p"); printf '%s=%s\n' "$p" "$value"; [ "$value" = 0 ]; done
printf '%s\n' 'POST_RESTART_VERIFICATION=PASS'

commands.command:
set -eu
cfg=/etc/sysctl.d/99-ipv4-network-hardening.conf
printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'SYSTEM_STATE='; systemctl is-system-running
printf 'NETWORK_MANAGER='; systemctl is-active NetworkManager
printf '%s\n' 'SYSTEMD_SYSCTL_BOOT_RESULT'; systemctl show systemd-sysctl.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result
printf '%s\n' 'PERSISTED_CONFIG'; cat "$cfg"
printf '%s\n' 'REQUIRED_RUNTIME_VALUES'
for key in net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route; do value=$(sysctl -n "$key"); printf '%s=%s\n' "$key" "$value"; [ "$value" = 0 ]; grep -Eq "^[[:space:]]*${key}[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*0([[:space:]]*|[[:space:]]*#.*)$" "$cfg"; done
printf '%s\n' 'RECOVERED_IPV4_STATE'; ip -4 -brief address show dev eth0; ip -4 route show
ip -4 address show dev eth0 | grep -Fq "$NODE_IP/"
gateway=$(ip -4 route show default | awk 'NR == 1 {print $3}')
[ -n "$gateway" ]
ping -c 2 -W 2 "$gateway"
printf '%s\n' 'FINAL_VERIFICATION=PASS'
